author: Sylin Labs
name: Koan Web API
description: A minimal Koan web API — the canonical 4-line Program.cs, one Entity<T> + EntityController, Sqlite, full REST auto-mapped. Ready to run.

manualInstructions.text:
Run it:
  dotnet run

Then POST and GET /api/todos. It persists across restarts.

Working with a coding agent:
  AGENTS.md orients any agent to this application and to Koan's capability map.
  Claude Code also gains the koan, koan-explain, and koan-upgrade skills once you trust this folder.
